Luminaires - Part 1: General requirements and tests
scope: Specifies general requirements and tests applicable to most luminaires including LED.

scope: Requirements for flood lights including LED, used for outdoor and stadium lighting.

title: Code of Practice for Lighting of Public Thoroughfares: Part 1 and 2 General Principles and Lighting for Main and Secondary Traffic Routes
scope: Provides general principles and lighting guidelines for main and secondary traffic routes to ensure safety.

title: Code of Practice for Lighting of Public Thoroughfares: Part 3 Lighting for Residential Roads and Pedestrian Areas
scope: Guidelines for lighting residential roads and pedestrian zones.

title: Code of Practice for Lighting of Public Thoroughfares: Part 5 Lighting for Grade Separated Junctions, Bridges and Elevated Roads
scope: Guidelines for lighting complex infrastructure such as grade-separated junctions, bridges, and elevated roads.

title: Code of Practice for Lighting of Public Thoroughfares: Part 6 Lighting for Town Centres and Areas of Civic Importance
scope: Guidelines for lighting town centers and civic areas.

title: General Lighting - LEDs and LED modules - Terms and Definitions
scope: Specifies terms and definitions for LEDs and LED modules used in general lighting.

title: PVC Insulated Cables for Working Voltages up to and Including 1100 V
scope: This standard covers PVC insulated cables with copper or aluminium conductors, rated up to 1100 V for fixed wiring in buildings, industrial plants, and similar applications.
scope_summary: PVC insulated cables for fixed wiring up to 1100V — copper or aluminium conductors.

title: PVC Insulated (Heavy Duty) Electric Cables - Part 1: For Working Voltages up to and Including 1100 V
scope: Heavy duty PVC insulated electric cables with copper or aluminium conductors for working voltages up to 1100 V. Includes armoured and unarmoured types for industrial installations, mines, and distribution systems.
scope_summary: Heavy duty PVC insulated cables up to 1100V — for distribution systems, industrial and mining applications, armoured and unarmoured.

title: Cross Linked Polyethylene (XLPE) Insulated Thermoplastic Sheathed Cables - Part 1: For Working Voltages from 3.3 kV up to and Including 11 kV
scope: XLPE insulated, thermoplastic sheathed cables for working voltages from 3.3 kV to 11 kV (medium voltage). For power distribution and transmission underground.
scope_summary: XLPE insulated medium voltage underground cables, 3.3kV to 11kV — for power distribution and transmission.

title: Cross Linked Polyethylene (XLPE) Insulated Thermoplastic Sheathed Cables - Part 2: For Working Voltages from 33 kV up to and Including 66 kV
scope: XLPE insulated cables for high voltage (HV) applications 33 kV to 66 kV. Used for underground transmission of electrical energy.
scope_summary: XLPE insulated high voltage cables, 33kV to 66kV — for underground power transmission.

title: Energy Efficient Induction Motors - Three Phase Squirrel Cage - Specification
scope: This standard specifies energy efficiency classes (IE1, IE2, IE3, IE4) for three-phase squirrel cage induction motors, 0.12 kW to 1000 kW, 50 Hz. Covers full load efficiency, power factor, current, slip, and temperature rise. BIS CRS mandatory under QCO 2018.
scope_summary: Energy efficiency classes IE1-IE4 for three-phase squirrel cage induction motors, 0.12 kW to 1000 kW, 50 Hz.

title: Power Transformers - Part 1: General Requirements
scope: General requirements for power transformers. Covers ratings, markings, tests, and limits for losses. Applicable to distribution and transmission transformers.
scope_summary: General requirements for power transformers — ratings, losses, tests, markings for distribution and transmission.

title: Dry-Type Power Transformers - General Requirements
scope: Requirements for dry-type (air-cooled) power transformers. Covers ratings, losses, temperature rise classes, insulation levels, and test requirements for industrial and commercial installations.
scope_summary: General requirements for dry-type air-cooled power transformers — for industrial and commercial installations.

title: LED Road and Street Luminaire - Performance Requirements
scope: Performance requirements for LED road and street luminaires. Covers photometric requirements: luminous flux, luminous efficacy (lm/W), colour rendering index (CRI), correlated colour temperature (CCT), colour consistency, lumen maintenance (L70/L80), power factor, THD, and minimum IP66 for outdoor LED street lighting.
scope_summary: LED road and street luminaire performance — luminous efficacy, CCT, CRI, L70 lumen maintenance, IP66, power factor for outdoor lighting.

title: AC Static Watt-Hour Meters for Active Energy (Classes 1 and 2)
scope: Requirements for static (solid state, electronic) AC watt-hour meters for active energy with accuracy classes 1 and 2. Applicable to single-phase and three-phase meters used in electricity distribution and metering.
scope_summary: Static AC electricity meters for active energy measurement — Classes 1 and 2 accuracy.

title: Low Voltage Switchgear and Controlgear Assemblies - Part 1: General Rules
scope: Requirements for assemblies of low-voltage switchgear and controlgear (LV switchboards, MCCBs, distribution boards, motor control centres). Covers design verification and testing for LV panels up to 1000V AC or 1500V DC.
scope_summary: Low voltage switchgear and controlgear assemblies — LV switchboards, distribution boards, MCCs up to 1000V AC.

title: Code of Practice for Earthing
scope: Code of practice for earthing (grounding) of electrical installations. Covers earth electrodes, earth continuity conductors, protective bonding, and testing. Applicable to all LV and MV electrical installations.
scope_summary: Code of practice for earthing of electrical installations — earth electrodes, bonding, testing, LV/MV systems.

title: Self Ballasted LED Lamps for General Lighting Services - Safety Requirements
scope: Safety requirements for self-ballasted LED lamps (LED bulbs) for general lighting services. Covers lamp construction, insulation, thermal requirements, photobiological safety, and test methods at supply voltages above 50V.
scope_summary: Safety requirements for self-ballasted LED lamps — LED bulbs for general lighting, thermal and electrical safety.
